```yaml
name: Integration Tests (.NET Aspire)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Build & Validate Aspire Integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore GZCTF.sln

      - name: Build Solution
        run: dotnet build GZCTF.sln --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Validate AppHost Configuration
        run: |
          # Verify AppHost project exists and builds
          if [ ! -f "GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj" ]; then
            echo "::error::GZCTF.AppHost project not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify ServiceDefaults project exists and builds
          if [ ! -f "GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj" ]; then
            echo "::error::GZCTF.ServiceDefaults project not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Build specific Aspire projects to ensure configuration is valid
          dotnet build GZCTF.AppHost/GZCTF.AppHost.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore
          dotnet build GZCTF.ServiceDefaults/GZCTF.ServiceDefaults.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run Unit Tests (Non-Aspire dependent)
        run: |
          # Run tests that do not require the full Aspire DCP environment
          # Exclude integration tests that require running services if they exist
          dotnet test GZCTF.sln --configuration Release --no-build --filter "Category!=Integration&Category!=Aspire" --verbosity normal

      - name: Verify Documentation
        run: |
          # Ensure required documentation files exist
          files=("docs/ASPIRE.md" "docs/aspire-deployment.md" "docs/ASPIRE_SUMMARY.md" "docs/ASPIRE_SECURITY.md" "docs/ASPIRE_TESTING.md")
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
              echo "::error::Missing documentation file: $file"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "All required documentation files present."

      - name: Check for Aspire Dashboard Dependencies in CI
        run: |
          # Note: Full Aspire Dashboard requires DCP which is not available in standard CI runners.
          # This step confirms we are skipping full orchestration tests as per documentation.
          echo "Skipping full Aspire Dashboard orchestration tests in CI."
          echo "Refer to docs/ASPIRE_TESTING.md for local testing instructions."

      - name: Upload Build Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: aspire-build-artifacts
          path: |
            **/bin/Release/**
            **/obj/Release/**
          retention-days: 7
```
